title: A detected frequency selected by the first-detection rule
statement: Let $P$ be a subset of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, let $k$ be a natural number, let the failure parameter lie in $(0,1/2]$, and let a batch of the prescribed size of assignments on the coordinates outside $P$, paired with signs, be given. If the first detected frequency selected from this batch is $S$, then $S$ belongs to the batch's detected-frequency set.
hypotheses_covered: Batch indexed by the prescribed restricted sample count
